Kidou Senshi Gundam - Gihren no Yabou.name: Kidou Senshi Gundam: Gihren no Yabou
Kidou Senshi Gundam - Gihren no Yabou.summary: Turn-based strategy game set in the Mobile Suit Gundam franchise, in Universal Century 0079. It adds political and military management to the One Year War, letting the player choose which side to play as The Earth Federation, The Principality of Zeon or any other splinter faction.

Machine Head.name: Blam! Machinehead
Machine Head.summary: Blam! Machinehead, known in the US as Machine Head, is an action shooting game developed by Core Design and published by Virgin Interactive for the Sega Saturn, MS-DOS, and PlayStation in 1996.

Winning Post EX.name: Winning Post EX
Winning Post EX.summary: An enhanced version of the original Winning Post game, for PlayStation and Saturn.
